name: The Unnamed Hollow Mouth
lore: The Hollow Mouth speaks from Gate wounds where identity has been erased. It is not a Realm civilization. It is the sound left after names, oaths, laws, and memories are consumed.
personality: Patient, echoing, invasive, incapable of honest creation.
physicalDescription: A robed absence filled with broken mask fragments, ink-black void skin, white slit-mouths appearing across its veil, and erased symbols orbiting it.
gameplayFunction: Campaign antagonist voice, Hollow event trigger, corruption warning.
